newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Holiday mood slows sales.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Holiday mood slows sales.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat cash bids were a shade higher on Thursday, reflecting a one-cent gain in MGE spring wheat futures, cash grain dealers said.
"The only thing moving today is the (MGE) board -- and maybe a little snow," one Montana dealer said.
Merchants reported very slow farmer selling and said the country continued to operate in a holiday mode.
Wednesday's Christmas holiday stalled movement this week and the New Year's Day holiday next week was expected to keep activity subdued, several dealers noted.
Selling was expected to resume in early January.
"We won't see any significant sales this week but when those bills start coming in around the first of the month, we should see things pick up," one North Dakota dealer said.
